notes: Battery and noise control on the Xiaomi 0000fd2d service, as the Redmi Buds 5's, behind a mutual authentication the earbuds require before they answer anything (a SAFER+ challenge each way, checked against the bridge's own computation). After it, the reads and sets are the Buds 5's frames. These earbuds repeat each of their own announcements (0E, F4) until it is answered, so the bridge answers each one; and their status reports carry the batteries (attribute 0), charging bit included. The frames are verbatim from the capture: the third run (the handshake, the reads and the off, cancelling, transparency sets, our challenge fixed to the one sent there) and the fourth (a long press, the battery reports with the left bud going into the case). The Fast Pair Message Stream is not in their record.
